verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਦੀਪਤ ਪਤੰਗ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਤ ਹੋਤ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਕੈ ਜਾਰਾ ਮੈ ਪਰਤ ਜਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dheep dheepat pata(n)g loT pot hot kabahoo(n) kai jaaraa mai parat jar jai hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a moth is enamored by the flame of a lamp, circles around it, and one day falls in the flame and burns himself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਖਗ ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਿ ਆਵੈ ਉਡਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਦਿਨ ਫਾਸੀ ਫਾਸੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise khag dhin prat chog chug aavai udd kaahoo dhin faasee faasai bahur na aai hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a bird picks grains and worms the whole day and return to his nest as the sun sets, but some day, it is caught in the net of a bird catcher and does not return to its nest.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਖੋਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਕਮਲ ਦਲ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise al kamal kamal prat khojai nit kabahoo(n) kamal dhal sa(n)paT samai hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a black bee keep searching and smelling elixir from various lotus flowers, but one day it is caught in the boxlike flower.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਬਾਨੀ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਕਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਮਗਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਸਬਦ ਉਰਝਾਇ ਹੈ ॥੫੯੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise gurbaanee avagaahan karat chit kabahoo(n) magan havai sabadh urajhai hai ||590||

en.bdb: Similarly, a seeker perpetually dives in Gurbani, but some day he becomes so engrossed in Gurbani that he is absorbed in Guru's words.  (590)
